newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan May overseas ship orders up 242.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan May overseas ship orders up 242.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Ship export contracts concluded by Japanese shipyards in May totalled 38 vessels, or 1.19 million gross registered tonnes (grt), the Japan Ship Exporters' Association (JSEA) said on Wednesday.
This represented a sharp 242.3 percent increase from May 1996 when contracts for nine vessels, or 348,550 grt were concluded, the association said in a statement.
Orders for May included two freighters, 26 bulk carriers and eight oil tankers, including one very large crude carrier (VLCC), the JSEA said.
Contracts for fiscal 1997/98 which started in April now amount to 57 vessels, or 1.94 grt, the association said.
